payload.reason: The evidence describes the process of crowdsourced annotations, including the involvement of non-expert annotators and expert reviewers, as well as the validation of annotations through majority voting.

claims.text: Crowdsourced annotations involve non-expert contributors labeling tweets, which are then validated by majority voting among multiple annotators.
Expert reviewers correct annotations where crowdworkers disagree, ensuring higher reliability in the labeled data.
The annotation process includes evaluating tweets with varying confidence scores to improve model accuracy.
